name: Data Visualization
description: Visualizing data effectively and building dashboards.

subskills.name: Basic Chart Types
subskills.description: Choosing appropriate charts (bar, line, scatter, pie) for the data.

subskills.name: Basic Dashboards
subskills.description: Creating simple dashboards in Excel or basic BI tools.

subskills.name: Color Theory
subskills.description: Applying color palettes effectively for accessibility and emphasis.

subskills.name: Interactive Plots (Plotly)
subskills.description: Building interactive visualizations using libraries like Plotly or Bokeh.

subskills.name: BI Tools (Tableau/PowerBI)
subskills.description: Developing enterprise dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, Looker, etc.

subskills.name: Data Storytelling
subskills.description: Structuring visual narratives to drive business decisions.

subskills.name: Custom Visualizations
subskills.description: Creating highly customized visuals beyond standard chart types.

subskills.name: D3.js / Advanced
subskills.description: Programming bespoke, low-level web visualizations using D3.js.

github.signal: Python script using interactive visualization libraries

cv.signal: Experience with Tableau or Power BI

linkedin.signal: Data Visualization or BI tools endorsed

assessment.signal: Can design a dashboard layout selecting the correct chart types for KPIs

junior.description: Can produce standard charts and assemble basic reports.

mid.description: Can build interactive enterprise BI dashboards and tell a cohesive data story.

senior.description: Can architect custom visualization solutions and bespoke visual components.
